title: Promo Code
content: Build promo/coupon code input component. Structure: flex row with input and Apply button. Input: text field with placeholder "Enter promo code", uppercase transform. Apply button: loading state while validating. Validation states: checking (spinner), valid (green check, show discount), invalid (error message). Applied state: show code as removable pill with discount amount. Error messages for expired, invalid, or minimum not met.

variants.simple: Create promo code input with Apply button and validation feedback.
variants.detailed: Build promo/coupon code input component. Structure: flex row with input and Apply button. Input: text field with placeholder "Enter promo code", uppercase transform. Apply button: loading state while validating. Validation states: checking (spinner), valid (green check, show discount), invalid (error message). Applied state: show code as removable pill with discount amount. Error messages for expired, invalid, or minimum not met.
variants.advanced: Build promo/coupon code input component with comprehensive validation. Structure: flex gap-2 with input (flex-1) and Apply button. Input: text field with placeholder "Enter promo code" or "Discount code", text-transform uppercase (CSS or on input), font-mono for code appearance, border rounded-lg px-4 py-2. Apply button: px-6 py-2 bg-gray-900 text-white rounded-lg, or outline variant. States: "Apply" default, loading spinner while validating (disabled), "Applied" success state. Validation flow: on Apply click, validate code against backend, show appropriate feedback. States with UI: idle (default appearance), checking (input disabled, button shows Loader2 animate-spin), valid (input border-green-500, green Check icon inside, button changes to "Applied" or checkmark), invalid (input border-red-500, shake animation, error message below). Applied state display: replace input with applied code pill (bg-green-100 text-green-800 px-3 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2) showing code text and X remove button. Show discount amount/percentage applied ("20% off" or "-$25.00"). Error messages (text-red-600 text-sm below input): "This code has expired", "Minimum purchase of $50 required", "Code not found", "This code has already been used", "One code per order". Multiple codes: if allowed, show stacked pills for each applied code, input remains for adding more. Remove code: X button removes code and recalculates totals. Auto-apply feature: support ?promo=CODE URL parameter for promo links, auto-apply on page load. Suggestions section: "Available promotions" collapsible showing applicable codes user can click to apply (SUMMER20, FREESHIP). Success feedback: brief green highlight animation when discount applied, toast notification optional. Persistent: remember applied code in sessionStorage, restore on page refresh. Input validation: trim whitespace, handle case-insensitive codes. Keyboard: Enter key triggers Apply. Accessibility: aria-describedby linking input to error message, announce success/failure to screen readers.
